title: NA60011: Marine Acoustics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Theory and applications of Ocean Acoustics â physical and biological
characteristics of the sea, ocean stratification, sound speed and ray
refraction, remote sensing by scatter, passive acoustics, variability of oceans
and its effect on acoustics, sound scattering at ocean surface, sound
scattering by air bubbles, ocean bottom effects, ambient noise, application of
underwater acoustics in practical problems, acoustic tomography; Ray theory of
sound field in the Ocean âRefraction of sound rays, horizontal distance traced
by ray; sound intensity, focusing factors and caustics, three dimensional
refraction; Plane waves â reflection from surface and bottom, reflection and
transmission coefficients at interface, wave reflection at liquid layered
bottom, reflection from homogeneous layers, reflection from arbitrary number of
layers, reflection from continuously layered bottom; Sound propagation in
shallow water âNormal modes in a two layered liquid, average decay law, layer
with negative refraction, convergence zones, Density dependence of sound
propagation in oceans - SOFAR channel estimation â practical problem to
estimate optimum SOFAR channel depth in oceans; SONAR systems â generic SONAR,
echo identification rules, SONAR equations; Scattering of Sound â role of gas
bubbles in sound scattering, sound scattering by single ideal bubble,
scattering and absorption of sound by real bubble, dispersion of sound
velocity; reverberation, surface and volume reverberation.
